stories.title: LSU vs. FSU Game 2 at Orange Beach — TODAY at Noon CT
stories.angle: The two-game Orange Beach Softball Stadium showcase continues today with Game 2 at noon CT (1 PM ET). FSU arrived at the venue 52-1 on fall ball; LSU came in at 40-19. The first game of this series was yesterday; today's rematch closes one of the highest-profile fall showcases of the fall 2026 schedule. Admission is $10 cash. Both programs are considered top-10 national title contenders for 2027.

stories.title: Tennessee's Final Public Fall Event — Free Intersquad Oct 29
stories.angle: With their fall schedule complete, Tennessee holds their last public event of the fall — a free intersquad scrimmage Thursday, October 29 at 5 PM ET at Sherri Parker Lee Stadium. Coach Karen Weekly said after the Lee University finale that she wishes the fall schedule had tougher competition; this intersquad is the last chance to evaluate hitters against real pitching before winter. The Vols' pitching staff — Karlyn Pickens (194 K, 1.70 ERA), Sage Mardjetko (16-3, 1.26 ERA), and freshman Bailee Shelton (3 IP, 7 K, Lee game) — is arguably the deepest in the country.

stories.title: 2028 Recruiting — EE100 Pitchers Drop Monday, Top-5 Reveal This Week
stories.angle: The Extra Elite 100 class of 2028 pitchers rankings (#201-300) are expected to drop Monday, October 27. The EE100 Top-5 reveal is also expected this week, giving fans the first look at who Extra Inning Softball considers the top overall recruit in the biggest class ever (1,200+ nominations). The contact window remained open through Oct 24-25, so expect a fresh wave of commits. Texas leads the overall class with Michaela Landers (No. 1 overall, IF) and four others. Florida's Kylie Holden holds No. 2. OU and Tennessee both have 5 commits each.

stories.title: Texas Tech's New Era Takes Shape — Pickering, Heavener, and the No. 1 Portal Class
stories.angle: Texas Tech closed their fall schedule yesterday, giving new head coach Kasey Cottrill her first full look at the program. The roster is built around the No. 1 transfer portal class in program history, headlined by Kasidi Pickering (.384 BA, 50 HR, 169 RBI in three seasons at OU), who signed with TTU in June. Along with Beachum (FSU transfer), Heavener, Polar, and Gallaway, the Red Raiders have assembled genuine WCWS-contender talent around Cottrill and associate HC Jacy Pendley. Big 12 play opens March 12.
